name: Shigatsu wa Omae no Tame ni Aru
source:
Born in a small village as a prostitute's daughter—"I"...was actually the king's illegitimate child!?

"I want money" "I want subjects" "I want a kingdom"

I'll make those wishes come true by seducing the princes (my stepbrothers)!!

Of course, I could also stage a coup and seize them by force!!

A romance game where you take over the kingdom by seducing your stepbrothers or staging a coup.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12823]Novelgame[/url]]
